The main takeaway from our work is that
the energy harvester can be modeled by a simple second order system, where only the mechanical part is considered.

the piezoelectric cantilever beam harvester can be modeled by means of an electrical equivalent circuit, which is composed of a mechanical part, which represents the mechanical structure of the harvester, and an electrical part, which represents its electrical properties.
piezoelectric cantilever energy harvesters can be well described by an electrical equivalent circuit composed of a voltage source and a parallel combination of a capacitor and a resistor.
